notes.title: Update Notes - 06/07/2023
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/07eecf33caf911dbbdded6e56e4a93c0a222eea7.png
In the past, a few players reported issues with Steam achievements not triggering correctly. In this update, we have added additional detection functionality in the game. Players experiencing this issue are advised to re-enter the game and load their saved files, as this should fix the majority of the problems. Thank you for your understanding.


1.0.5 Patch Note


 Added achievement unlock detection feature.

notes.title: Update Notes - 05/29/2023
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/07eecf33caf911dbbdded6e56e4a93c0a222eea7.png
We have heard the voices of all the players!
The long-awaited cloud save feature, which has been requested by many, has finally been implemented due to certain technical issues.

In addition, we have received feedback from players regarding the gameplay of the shopkeeper. Some players found it inconvenient to “use” while playing the mini-games. Therefore, we have created a "Viewing Mode" that allows you to free up your hands~


1.0.4 Patch Note


 Artbook updated with new illustrations of the shopkeeper.
 Added cloud save functionality.
 Added a viewing mode for H-scenes with the shopkeeper.

notes.title: Update Notes - 05/19/2023
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/4ddaa34500a82a5173b573ff19a02cedb85daffa.png
Hi, we have just released an update earlier. Besides being able to interact with the shopkeeper sister, we have also added CGs for the endings of the three characters.

All of these contents are available as a free update! However, if you would like to show us additional support, you may consider purchasing the newly released digital art collection! (Please note that the text in the art collection is only available in Traditional Chinese, we apologize for any inconvenience.)

Wish you all have fun in Handyman Legend.
Thanks!

1.0.3 Patch Note


 New updates related to the shopkeeper have been added (unlocked after purchasing all items).
 The information page now includes a new ending for the female character. (which can be unlocked after she has fallen.)

notes.title: Development update! about the Free DLC
notes.notes:
Some of our fans might already figure out,
yes! The underdevelopment DLC character is the convenience store/mystery shop clerk! and this time we will provide new art style and new game play!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/dee6b7572bd050f8058e92dfa86d72a77860892c.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/897fa257fd0bb74eca011de2c2ffc0e0fa95c64b.png
▲The “interact” icon will reveal once you reach a certain condition.

Unlike other characters, the interaction with the clerk will be seen as full screen this time! please look forward to it!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/5cd9f4ab6900f4b545b192cff82fe2f5037cfc62.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/f4ab948f5157c692205c311501104c3419b78283.gif
▲a sample screenshot of the new gameplay. A new UI will be added in the next version.

The artwork is nearly finished, should be done by mid-April, followed by some adjustment and game play development, hopefully be out in the following month?

Since it is a completely new character and has two forms, the development time will be a little longer than we originally estimated, but we hope it will be worth waiting for!!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42925789/ca39d3fbf2fd516e72bb572c99350d1fbcd49f51.png
▲This is one of the mini game you need to challenge with the shop clerk, can anyone find out what is this game about?

Stay tuned with us and hopefully  you guys will like the new update!(๑•ั็ω•็ั๑)
